enabled.description: Enable the Mir X11 kiosk service. When false, the service will not start.

display_number.description: X11 display number (e.g., :0 → set to 0, :1 → set to 1).

app_command.description: Path to the X11 application to run in kiosk mode.

app_args.description: Command-line arguments for the X11 kiosk application.

work_dir.description: Working directory for the kiosk app process (optional). Leave empty to use default.

user.description: Unix user under which the kiosk app runs.

group.description: Unix group under which the kiosk app runs.

env_vars.description: Custom environment variables to set before launching the kiosk app.

auto_restart.description: Automatically restart the kiosk app if it crashes or exits.

restart_delay.description: Seconds to wait before restarting the app after a crash (used if auto_restart = true).

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warn, or error.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. If empty, logs go to syslog only.

start_timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds allowed for app startup before timeout.

wayland_display.description: Path to the Mir Wayland display socket.

x11_window_class.description: X11 window class hint (for window manager rules).

cursor_policy.description: Mouse cursor visibility: 'visible' or 'hidden' (recommended for kiosk).

input_devices.description: List of input devices to expose to the kiosk app. Empty or 'none' disables all input.

input_policy.description: Input policy: 'all', 'none', or 'list'. If 'list', use input_devices above.

multi_display.description: Enable multi-display support. If false, only primary display is used.

display_order.description: List of display names in preferred order (for multi-display setups).

fallback_display.description: Fallback display name if none detected (e.g., 'eDP-1').

surface_buffer_count.description: Number of surface buffers (2 = double buffering, 3 = triple).

gpu_device.description: GPU device path (e.g., /dev/dri/card0). Auto-detected if omitted.
